description: This PHP class 'FactoryRuntimeLoader' implements a lazy loader for runtime implementations of Twig elements, using a map of class names to factory callables.

classes.name: FactoryRuntimeLoader
classes.description: Implements a lazy loader for Twig runtime classes based on a provided class-to-factory map.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with an optional map of class names to factory functions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of the specified class if available in the map; otherwise, returns null.
